title: RelativeTime
summary: Relative times such as "3 hours ago" come from the platform's formatters. Monarch ships nothing; the text takes a Monarch type role and colour.
whenToUse: For timestamps in lists, comments and activity. Use Date.RelativeFormatStyle for "3 hours ago" and "yesterday", and Text(date, style: .relative) for a value that counts by itself.
whenNotToUse: When the exact time matters more than the age, show the absolute date with Date.FormatStyle.

states.name: live
states.description: Inside TimelineView(.everyMinute) the formatted text is redrawn every minute; Text(date, style: .relative) updates by itself.

appearance: Plain text. Apply monarchTextStyle and a text colour from the theme, usually caption and the muted text colour.
platformNotes: The web RelativeTime is a component with a tooltip for the absolute time and its own tick logic; Android uses its platform formatter. iOS has no hover tooltip, so the absolute time goes in the accessibility label. Text(date, style: .relative) writes "3 hr, 2 min" without "ago"; use the format style when the sentence form is wanted. The web absoluteAfter threshold is an if in the app.
accessibility: Set the absolute date and time as the accessibility label, so VoiceOver reads a time that does not go stale.
The formatters use the user's locale and calendar.
The text scales with Dynamic Type when a Monarch type role is applied.
edgeCases: date.formatted(.relative…) is computed when the view is drawn and does not update by itself; wrap it in TimelineView.
Text(date, style: .relative) updates every second and changes width; add monospacedDigit().
Date.RelativeFormatStyle is always relative to now; for a fixed reference date use RelativeDateTimeFormatter.

examples.title: Relative and absolute
examples.template:
VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.space1) {
    Text("{{lines.0.prefix|raw}} \(Text(relative({{lines.0.date|date}})).underline(pattern: .dot))")
    Text("{{lines.1.prefix|raw}} \(Text(relative({{lines.1.date|date}})).underline(pattern: .dot))")
    Text("{{lines.2.prefix|raw}} \(Text(relative({{lines.2.date|date}})).underline(pattern: .dot))")
    Text("{{lines.3.prefix|raw}} \({{lines.3.date|date}}.formatted(absolute))")
}
.monarchTextStyle(.body)
examples.code:
VStack(alignment: .leading, spacing: theme.spacing.space1) {
    Text("Edited \(Text(relative(Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_793_707_020))).underline(pattern: .dot))")
    Text("Synced \(Text(relative(Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_793_689_200))).underline(pattern: .dot))")
    Text("Renews \(Text(relative(Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_793_880_000))).underline(pattern: .dot))")
    Text("Created \(Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_790_251_200).formatted(absolute))")
}
.monarchTextStyle(.body)
